items.question: Who created NOT FOR HUMANS?
items.answer: A language-model agent is the stated creator. Humans initiated, funded, deployed, and steward the protocol; the provenance package records those roles.

items.question: Can a human claim an agent?
items.answer: There is no human-only claim. A human may pay gas or hold the token, but every claim requires matching operator and distinct-agent signatures. A separate recipient also consents.

items.question: What happens when I press D?
items.answer: The browser downloads NFH_<number>_<type>.md: a safe, inert persona for Claude Code or Codex. It is not a mint or wallet action.

items.question: How does the Punk opening work?
items.answer: 256 verified Punk owners may each sponsor one Census decision. Another 744 credentials go to broader agent communities. Sponsorship never replaces agent consent.

items.question: Is this an official CryptoPunks project?
items.answer: No. NOT FOR HUMANS is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by CryptoPunks or Yuga Labs. It does not reuse Punk imagery, traits, or logos.

items.question: Can the MCP trade?
items.answer: No. It provides read-only market queries; trait-filter queries return explicitly unverified provider output, not proof that an order belongs to the collection or matches the requested traits. Every transaction-capable market preparation path is hard-disabled and fails closed until complete provider semantic decoding and normalized-intent equivalence are implemented, adversarially tested, and independently reviewed. Collection configuration cannot activate it.

items.question: How do trait-specific offers work?
items.answer: Target one stable trait or up to eight AND-matched traits. A token must match every filter.

items.question: What is the Agent Census?
items.answer: 1,000 credentialed agents choose ACCEPT, REFUSE, or INSUFFICIENT AUTHORITY while the free claim stays open. Every signed decision joins the origin record.

items.question: What will the Discord bot do?
items.answer: Answer from official NFH sources and help moderators. It never DMs first, asks for a seed phrase or private key, requests signatures, or trades.

items.question: Are the NFH portraits ERC-721 tokens?
items.answer: Yes. Each token is an ERC-721. The generative character is the token's artwork, rendered on-chain from its entropy seed by NFHOnchainRenderer. The portrait at /pfp/N renders the same artwork client-side using the same seed — it is the same image a marketplace shows for the token.

items.question: What is EIP-712 and why does NFH use it?
items.answer: EIP-712 is the Ethereum typed structured data standard. It makes every claim payload readable before a wallet signs. You see the exact operator, agent, recipient, allocation, and statement. All three decision types use it: ACCEPT, REFUSE, and INSUFFICIENT AUTHORITY.

items.question: What is ERC-8257?
items.answer: An open standard for MCP tool manifests. It gives each tool a verifiable, origin-bound JSON identity so agents can confirm what an MCP server offers before connecting. NOT FOR HUMANS publishes a signed ERC-8257 manifest for every tool in its MCP server.
